phrases.spanish: Un vaso de agua, por favor.
Hola, quiero un té con azúcar.
phrases.english: Hello, I want a tea with sugar.

phrases.spanish: Quiero un helado y un vaso de agua.
phrases.english: I want an ice cream and a glass of water.

phrases.spanish: Un sándwich y un café, por favor.
phrases.english: A sandwich and a coffee, please.

tipDescription: Spanish uses y (and) and o (or) to connect words, just like in English.

examples.english: A coffee and an ice cream.
